<style>
#quarto-header, .navbar, .quarto-navbar, .page-footer, .nav-footer { display: none !important; }

.cv-header {

}

}

.cv-contact a {
  color: #000 !important;

}

  text-decoration: underline;
}

.cv-section {

}

}

.cv-entry {
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.cv-entry-header {

  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.cv-entry-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111 !important;
  font-family: "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif;
}

.cv-entry-date {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #666;
  font-style: italic;
}

.cv-entry-subtitle {
  font-style: italic;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.cv-entry-detail {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.cv-entry-detail strong {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111;
}

.cv-reference {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.cv-reference-name {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #4C0000;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.cv-reference-name:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.cv-reference-details {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.site-content a {
  color: #000 !important;
}

.site-content a:hover {
  color: #333 !important;
}

body.quarto-dark .cv-name,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-name { color: #f0f0f0 !important; }
body.quarto-dark .cv-section-title,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-section-title { color: #f0f0f0 !important; }

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-entry-title { color: #f0f0f0 !important; }

/* --- Download CV button --- */

.cv-download {
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
  padding-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #e3e3e3;
}

.cv-download-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5em;
  padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
  font-family: "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #fff !important;
  background-color: #111;
  border: 1px solid #111;
  border-radius: 3px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease;
}

.cv-download-btn:hover,
.cv-download-btn:focus-visible {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: #111 !important;
}

.cv-download-icon {
  width: 0.95em;
  height: 0.95em;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

/* Dark mode — invert so the button stays readable on a dark page */
body.quarto-dark .cv-download,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-download { border-top-color: #3a3a3a; }

body.quarto-dark .cv-download-btn,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-download-btn {
  color: #111 !important;
  background-color: #ededed;
  border-color: #ededed;
}

body.quarto-dark .cv-download-btn:hover,
body.quarto-dark .cv-download-btn:focus-visible,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-download-btn:hover,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-download-btn:focus-visible {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: #ededed !important;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .cv-entry-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .cv-name { font-size: 1.4rem; }
}
